findings.finding: Twelve manifest-listed log files are ignored by Git and ordinary staging omits them.
findings.resolution: Explicitly force-stage only the evidence bundle and compare every manifest entry to Git index bytes before commit; no ignore-rule change.

findings.finding: Check-run completion 10:55:18 is observation time; raw completion is 10:55:17.
findings.resolution: Correct report and append explicit spec clarification with raw check completion and observation timestamps.

findings.finding: Five skips were all described as opt-in, but two are unconditional placeholders.
findings.resolution: Report/ledger classify three opt-in facts and two unconditional placeholder facts; spec appends correction. No skip assertion or runtime gate changes.

findings.finding: Preservation receipt hashes predate the completed report and ledger.
findings.resolution: Refresh preservation after final report/ledger content; preserve interim/pre-review observations separately and verify document hashes in final bundle check.

findings.finding: Spec calls 2,021 Release outputs retained, while only their hash manifest is in the evidence bundle.
findings.resolution: Append explicit correction to agent-owned implementation notes, preserving chronology; report and bundle README say binaries remain in isolated checkout and hashes are retained.

findings.finding: Reproduction loop can hide an earlier failed suite when the final suite passes.
findings.resolution: Aggregate failures and return nonzero after all six invocations; actual source CI already has a blocking gate and remains unchanged.

findings.finding: Recorded parser requires a hardcoded temporary extraction directory absent from exported bundle.
findings.resolution: Document exact original prerequisite and historical-helper scope; add portable read-only verifier consuming retained ZIP directly with an evidence-directory argument.

findings.finding: Historical parser assigns source/run constants without checking archive metadata/digest.
findings.resolution: Retain historical transcript, document that it alone is not source attestation; portable verifier obtains source/run from raw API and checks checkout/artifact metadata plus original ZIP digest before parsing.

findings.finding: Historical parser accepts nine matching claims rows without exact unique expected variants.
findings.resolution: Portable verifier requires the exact five accessor/two cleanup/two issuance names, unique test/execution identities and Passed outcomes. Raw artifact already contains all expected variants.

findings.finding: Construction of derived provenance/final summaries is not retained as a reproducible helper.
findings.resolution: Add input-to-field reconstruction map and portable independent comparison/rederivation of core fields from raw metadata/log/TRX inputs; authored explanatory fields remain explicitly interpretation.

findings.finding: Report describes Aspire.Hosting.Testing as restored; only its central PackageVersion evaluates to 13.6.4.
findings.resolution: Distinguish central Testing pin from actual restored packages; no dependency change or retest warranted.

final_recheck.blind_hunter: All ten findings addressed; portable verifier passes; all 95 then-current manifest entries match staged bytes; no gitlinks; historical prefixes intact.
